units.source_text: 母亲的回答使我感到意外。

en.t: My mother's answer took me by surprise.

units.source_text: 她说那寺庙的权利早已转让给别人，仅有的田地也处理了，

en.t: She said that the rights to the temple had long since been transferred to someone else, and that even the little farmland they had was disposed of,

units.source_text: 还清父亲所欠的全部医疗费用，

en.t: so that all the medical expenses my father owed could be paid off,

units.source_text: 今后她孤身一人，打算投靠京都近郊加佐郡的伯父家，

en.t: and from now on, left all alone, she intended to go and rely on my uncle's household in Kasa District near Kyoto,

units.source_text: 她就是来告诉我这件事的。

en.t: and she had come to tell me just that.
